title: MV 8 directions + sprint on a single char sheet

posts.author: alasth
posts.body:
Hello everyone!
I have a question: is there a plugin for MV that allows both running sprites and character diagonal sprites on the same sheet?
I've found a lot of plugins that do either 8 directions or sprint/dash movement, but not both in the same plugin.
The only plugin that handles
both at the same time is TAA_CharacterPoses
but the problem is that it's very difficult to configure and works on different sheets (you need a separate sheet for the dash, one for the poses, etc.).
I use
Low's 8-direction char
and the sprint and 8 directions are on the same sheet.
I literally use hundreds of these sheets and I can't see myself cutting them out one by one to integrate them completely into TAA_CharacterPoses, which proposes to do this actor by actor... and event by event!
(On MZ, there's
VisuStella's Events_and_Movement_Core
, for example, which works really well.
Is there an equivalent on MV?
the principle would be to have a plugin that manages the 8 directions and automatically changes the char sheet index:
- when actor walks in a straight line => index = 0
- when actor walks diagonally => index = 1
- when actor sprint in a straight line => index = 2
- when actor sprint diagonally => index = 3
thanks a lot

posts.author: ATT_Turan
posts.body:
Remember you can configure the output of the 8D Character Creator, so just change the sheets to match what the plugin expects.
I'm not sure why you would've exported hundreds when you didn't have a plugin that worked with them yet, but it's certainly easier for you to edit that than to try to edit the plugin.
It's also possible to program GIMP with macros, so you can perform batch operations to a list of files in a folder.
